observations.text: Official manual: PRC-16 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-16 stage 1, SIV-71 changes into HAP-12.
In PRC-16 stage 2, HAP-12 changes into BEX-55.
In PRC-16 stage 4, LOQ-55 changes into terminal marker BEX-60.

In PRC-73 stage 2, RAV-98 changes into WAM-23.
In PRC-73 stage 4, CYN-59 changes into terminal marker WAM-94.
